error.summary: Two demonstrated failures: answer-bank cues solve every tested generated item, including all five delivered batch records; source-supported positive nonunit slopes are excluded. Package files and database content were not changed.

source_analysis.skill: Integrate n/(ax+b) by substitution and select the correct antiderivative.
reasoning_steps: Identify u=ax+b and its slope a.
Distinguish coefficient, sign and argument errors.
invariants: One constant numerator and nonconstant affine denominator.
Easy five-choice radio response with one correct answer.
Absolute-value logarithm and additive integration constant.
permitted_variations: Vary small coefficients, intercepts and slope signs while preserving workload.
Include positive nonunit slopes demonstrated by the canonical example.
Vary correct coefficient and argument roles within recognizable answer-bank structures.

source_replay.details: Five complete practice templates replay exactly. Canonical positive-slope parameters are rejected; q-49511 is excluded.

math.details: Independent differentiation of all choices across 60 records found exactly one correct answer per record, matching its key.

variety.details: All supported profiles and boundaries were sampled, but positive nonunit slopes are absent and answer-bearing bank roles remain fixed.

scope.details: Produced records preserve easy single-affine-substitution integration without additional prerequisites.

grading.details: Native grader accepted 60 independently verified correct choices and rejected 240 distractors.

rendering.details: Inspected six representative/counterfactual screenshots and all five delivered batch screenshots. Prompts, choices and solutions display correctly.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions, deterministic replay, runtime relocation, invalid-request rejection and manifest-file presence verified.

decision_variation.details: Bank-only strategy succeeds on 50/50 raw samples, 40/40 delivered samples and 5/5 actual batch records. Conditional probes also succeed. Counterfactual dependencies pass, but fixed answer roles remain.

findings.description: Answer-bank structure reveals the key without reading the integrand: same-argument banks with two negatives key the largest positive coefficient; those with three negatives key the negative proper fraction; mixed-argument banks key the sole positive unit-coefficient shifted logarithm. These rules survive UI shuffling and solve every delivered batch member.
findings.reproduction: Run the context Python executable on regression.py --candidate-records delivery-batch/accepted.json; it exits 1. Minimal case: generate(seed=8301, template='q-15707', parameters=[2,1,5]). Choose the largest positive coefficient from {2,1/2,-2,-1/2,1}. Complete record: counterfactual-records.json[0].
findings.requested_change: Revise bank and profile construction so correctness depends on the integrand rather than a fixed bank signature. Preserve source replay separately. Add deterministic batch-construction regressions against prospective records and actual delivery filtering, including seed 994860459, count 5, difficulty easy. Shuffling options or changing the seed is insufficient.

findings.description: The generator excludes every positive nonunit slope, including the canonical integral 3/(5x+2) and captured practice integral 2/(3x+5). Existing distractor collisions do not justify removing this taught operation.
findings.reproduction: Run audit.py with the context Python executable. generate(template='q-15707', parameters=[3,5,2]) raises ValueError; generate(template='q-49511', parameters=[2,3,5]) raises KeyError. Failures are retained in source-replay.json.
findings.requested_change: Support positive nonunit slopes by deriving n/a, denominator rendering, distractors and substitution solutions together. Replay canonical [3,5,2] and the complete q-49511 bank; explicitly document reconstruction of its missing key and solution.
